card.name: The word each after a count
card.fires_on: The word "each" right after a number, percentage or dose amount, closing a list of events or items that share that value.

modes.label: Event counts
modes.description: "each" after a patient count or percentage in lists of adverse events.
modes.example: Grade 1-2 pericardial effusion, peripheral edema, and face edema were reported in 1 patient<< each>>.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: "each" after a dose in mg, saying every injection or component has that amount.
modes.example: two, 2-mL subcutaneous injections of 160 mg<< each>>, administered on the same day

card.plain: It marks the word "each" that follows a number or dose and applies it to every item in a list.
